accepted_original_items: Establish usable native isolation and orchestration controls
Conditionally implement minimal adapter support and frozen startup inputs
Review/requalify and amend registration prospectively only if supported

demonstrated: Experimental client capability plus explicit selector chooses a named native permission profile
Controlled native commands allow declared reads and deny excluded reads/writes under the tested profile
Explicit app controls remove callable app tools in metadata
A model command read the allowed sentinel and another model command was denied the excluded sentinel
unestablished: Functioning isolated root/child orchestration common to both arms
A complete frozen startup inventory and its preservation across root/child launch
Server-side control-operation isolation if connectivity becomes available
All required writable paths, child inheritance and cross-arm separation
findings.decisive_observation: In raw model tool output, allowed sentinel read exits0 while the owned control-socket handshake exits1 with EPERM at socket.socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM), despite requested explicit Unix socket allowlist/proxy configuration. Existing role_host uses this AF_UNIX client.

limitations: A tested CLI0.166.0 route failure, not a universal Codex impossibility or a demonstrated control-plane bypass
Connection refusal in network-enabled probes does not establish full domain filtering
Metadata checks came from separate configurations, not one qualified end-to-end environment
The recorded binary digest is the installed JavaScript launcher digest, not a complete native executable pin
Custody wrapper exit0 means collection completed, not that every inner command passed
Earlier interrupted, environment-less and refusal attempts are not OS evidence or trial data
